parameters.content:
## A whole store from one link
Started by the Telegram bot when an admin sends a store's own link (no /products/ in it).

The run pauses at **Wait for Claude Code: New Store** (up to 7 days). A Claude Code session in the dtj-agency-automation folder (listening, or told "handle the Claude Code trigger in n8n") follows the skill dtj-new-store: store_job.py asks the questions and the Approve taps in Telegram, then the draft copy, the apps, the brand data and every page. Nothing is published; the live theme is never written.

Source in git: `n8n/store-factory/` (store_job.py, bot_ask.py) and `.claude/skills/dtj-new-store`.
